bugs_found: transfer() does not normalize amount to Decimal; float inputs can pass validation then raise TypeError during balance mutation, and Receipt may contain non-Decimal amount
transfer() is non-atomic: account_from is debited before account_to is credited, so a failure in account_to.balance addition or setter leaves money lost
fx_convert() lowercases lookup keys without normalizing the rates dict contract, silently rejecting rates keyed with original uppercase ISO currencies
fx_convert() does not validate rate positivity/finite value, allowing zero, negative, NaN, or Infinity FX rates to produce invalid money
compound_interest() and loan_payment() silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), causing undeclared behavior changes for fractional numeric inputs
apply_fee() can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, effectively charging more than the transaction value without explicit validation
